title: Template:Card/doc
text:
This is the documentation for [[Template:Card]], the card-page template. One page = one printing. Do '''not''' put empty errata sections on a card that was never errata'd. Optional '''card_status''' — a short status label for a printing that needs context outside the standard Decipher / Players Committee bands (for example, a cancelled design's community remaster). The label appears above the card template. Use only a sourced status; omit it for ordinary printings. Optional '''set_icon''' — printed expansion symbol. Always shown. Premiere = none (still shown). Pass none or a wikilink/file for the printed icon. Alias '''expansion_icon'''. When omitted, Premiere-family sets (Premiere Limited, Premiere Unlimited, Premiere Two-Player, Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game, Premiere, Japanese Premiere, Japanese Premiere Two-Player, ESB Two-Player) default to none; other sets show an empty cell until filled. Do not mass-restamp 24k articles. Optional '''also_in''' (alias '''products''') — leftover or extra products that shipped this same version (Enhanced Premiere boosters, First Anthology starters, Reflections I–III bulk). Named editions of the same cardboard stack in the article title instead. Omit when none. Optional '''publisher''' — publisher credited by the set article ([[Decipher]], [[Players Committee]], or a named person). Inherit from the set infobox. For a cancelled set, use its documented planned publisher; this does not imply that the cards were released. Renders after Also in when filled. Optional '''era''' — championship era hub: [[Decipher era]], [[Virtual Original]], [[Virtual Legacy]], or [[Virtual Modern]]. Renders after Publisher when filled. '''GEMP ID''' — the id GEMP actually loads, as set_card (for example 1220_51, 1_19). Bare on the current playable article, o on the first-published face, d only as a middle layer when print, Decipher errata, and PC errata are three distinct texts. Pass '''gemp_id''' or the older '''card_uid''' (alias). Optional '''gemp_id2''' — a second GEMP id when this version is a named edition of two constructed sets. Render both as adjacent spans, 2PG first ('''gemp_id''') then Unlimited ('''gemp_id2'''). Omit '''gemp_id2''' when empty. Worked: Imperial Barrier white 71_249 then 51_249. Shown in monospace. Dest keys such as pc|vbN|... belong in authoring JSON, not here. Infobox identity order: Set, Set icon, Also in, Publisher, Era, GEMP ID, then rarity/stats/gameplay Icons. Optional '''rarity''' and '''uniqueness''' — omit either field when the source does not establish it; no blank row is shown. Read uniqueness from the printed title marker: one bullet is Unique, no marker is Unrestricted, and multiple bullets use the corresponding Limited or Restricted value. For a combo, inspect the marker on both halves. If the title area is cropped or unreadable, omit uniqueness. Optional '''credits''' — count only the gold coin circles in the card’s bottom credit area, following the card’s orientation. The single gold badge beside the lore panel is not a credit. Show only positive Credits. Omit the parameter when there are no credit coins or the value is unknown; empty, null and zero values do not render a row. Keep confirmed zero distinct from unknown in the source-data ledger. Optional '''pc_alias''' — Players Committee GEMP alias (601_x / 501_x) when it differs from the GEMP ID. Optional '''slip''' — printed slip number on the virtual sheet (for example 51E). Data, not the id. '''Versions''' — family navigator (Option C, 26 October 2026; errata prefix 26 October 2026). Closed prefixes, oldest first: Decipher, Decipher (AI), Decipher Errata, PC Errata, Virtual Original, Virtual Legacy, Virtual Legacy (AI), Virtual Modern, Virtual Modern (ALT). Unmarked Decipher is the printed face. Decipher Errata is a later Decipher rewrite. PC Errata only when the Players Committee rewrote past Decipher. Full lineage both directions. Omit when this printing is the only one. Host twins that share one GEMP id use one line plus a hatnote. Pass '''versions''' or the older '''printings''' (alias). Bold the current-printing label and place its GEMP ID in . Worked: [[Luke Skywalker]]. Do not pass '''version_label'''. The old Version row (printed / virtual) is dropped. Era and Versions already mark Players Committee printings as Virtual Original, Virtual Legacy, or Virtual Modern. Optional '''version_code''' (Bill, 2026-11-08) — this page's errata version: <Issuer>-E<n>, where the issuer is D (Decipher) or PC (Players Committee) and n counts that card's published changes in date order, rephrases included (PC-E1, PC-E2…). Renders as '''Errata version''' above the Errata mark. Omit it on the original printed face, which has no code. It is our version id, not a printed stamp: the stamp printed on the card goes in '''errata_mark''' as printed (E1, D-E1). Page titles stay as in the Style guide: plain = original, then (Errata), (Errata 2), (Errata 3). Worked: [[Hindsight (V) (Errata)]] = PC-E1. Optional '''likeness''' — person whose face is on the card: a photographic model Decipher (or the Players Committee) cast, or the film portrayer of that character. Wiki-link the person page. Worked: [[Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand]] → [[Shannon Baksa]]; [[Aurra Sing]] / [[Aurra Sing (AI)]] → [[Michonne Bourriague]]. Omit when the art is illustration, a starship/weapon, or a later virtual photograph that is not that person. Optional PC label fields (swccg-guild/work#100) — the small labels the Players Committee prints on a Virtual card, copied by bot from billbisco/swccg-gemp card_labels.json; correct them there, not here, or the next bot run puts the old value back. '''original_title''' — the black title strip at the bottom left (the title of the card this one was made from; on Virtual Legacy cards the slip title). '''original_title_italic''' — yes when the whole strip is italic, or the italic part (for example Executor). '''errata_mark''' — the errata stamp, bottom right (E1, D-E1). '''ai_mark''' — the alternate-image stamp as printed, (AI) or (ALT). '''concept_credit''' — the "Original concept by …" line. '''art_credit''' — the art credit printed beside the art ("Image courtesy of …"). '''dedication''' — an "In memory of …" line in the bottom bar. '''printed_label''' — any other small printed line (for example a contest name on the card's edge). '''copyright_line''' — the vertical copyright line beside the art, as printed (the standard "ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD." too; Virtual Block lines are recorded only where legible). The '''Alternate-image stamp''' row shows the Players Committee logo printed beside (AI)/(ALT). Worked: [[Endless Legions]] (original title, concept and art credits); [[Executor: Control Station (V)]] (partly italic title, Decipher copyright line). All are omitted when the card doesn't print them. Optional '''reviews''' — published reviews of this card (fan-site or magazine), one bullet each: reviewer, outlet, date when known, rating if given, a short summary and a brief quote, cited with a carrying the Preserved copy (set '''has_refs'''). Renders as '''Reviews''' after Strategy. Omit when none. Worked: [[Chasm]] (Jeff Hansen, Neglected Card Series). Optional '''anagram''' — one sentence that the printed title is an anagram of a named person. Renders as '''Anagram'''. Adds [[:Category:Anagrams]]. Omit when none. Link [[Anagrams]] from See also. Worked: [[Nabrun Leids]] → [[Tom Braunlich]]. Optional '''joke''' — a joke in this printing's title, lore or game text, cited (or approved by Bill, with the approval on the card's Talk page). Renders as '''Joke''' directly after '''Anagram'''. Adds [[:Category:Jokes]]. Omit when none. Link [[Jokes]] from See also. Worked: [[Swing-And-A-Miss]]. Optional '''easter_egg''' — the hidden picture, icon, likeness or other visual detail on this printing, cited. Renders as '''Easter egg''' immediately before See Also. Adds [[:Category:Easter eggs]]. Omit when none. Link [[Easter eggs]] from See also. Worked: [[Death Star: Trench]]. '''sources''' — card-data sources supplied here (card list, slip, PDF). Give each source its own bullet with a Preserved copy. The template renders a '''Sources''' heading only when filled. Do not repeat a source already cited with for one claim. List it here again only when it supplies the entire card entry. '''has_refs''' — set when the page has notes; renders '''References'''. '''see_also''' renders '''See Also''' only when filled. Optional '''image2''' — second portrait under '''image''' (same 280px width). Used for Objective 0/7 faces; omit on single-face cards. Optional '''image2_trim''' — display-only trim for excess padding on the second image. A value of 20 requests a 320px thumbnail and hides 20px on each edge inside a 280px-wide rounded window. Measure each image separately and preserve a normal black border, all text and all symbols. The source File and downloaded image are unchanged. Omit for ordinary images. Optional '''image2_layout''' — how to place '''image2''' when set: * omit or '''stack''' — force stacked vertically (0 on top, 7 below); default when unset * '''right''' — force side-by-side always (0 left, 7 right); classes '''card-portraits-row''' + '''card-rail-dual''' * '''responsive''' — preferred Objective mode: wide viewport = side-by-side (0 left, 7 right); narrow viewport (max-width '''720px''') = stacked. Same row/dual markup plus '''card-rail-responsive''' / '''card-portraits-responsive''' so CSS media query can adapt. Optional '''image3''', '''image4''', '''image5''', '''image6''' — further portraits, each 280px wide, with matching '''image3_trim''' … '''image6_trim''' (same rule as '''image2_trim'''). Used for the printed slip on [[Virtual Legacy]] card pages (swccg-guild/work#156), as '''image2''' shows the slip on [[Virtual Original]] pages. * Stacked layout (no '''image2_layout'''): they follow '''image2''' in order, top to bottom. A single-face card whose '''image2''' is free puts its slip in '''image2'''; a card whose '''image2''' is taken puts the slip in '''image3''' (a slip printed in two halves uses the next free slots, top half first). * '''right''' / '''responsive''' layout (two-sided Objectives): when '''image3''' or '''image4''' is set the portraits form two columns. The left column is '''image''' (0 side), '''image3''', '''image5'''; the right column is '''image2''' (7 side), '''image4''', '''image6'''. Put the 0 side's slip in '''image3''' and the 7 side's in '''image4'''; when a side's slip is printed in two halves, its second half goes in '''image5''' (0 side) or '''image6''' (7 side). In narrow (responsive) view the left column stacks above the right. Without '''image3'''/'''image4''' the layout is unchanged.

[[Category:Templates]] == Creature statistics == Optional creature statistics: ferocity and fangs render their own Info rows when supplied. Use the printed creature statistics rather than recording ferocity as power. The optional tentacles parameter displays a creature’s printed tentacle count. Like ferocity and fangs, the row is omitted when the parameter is empty. == Blanked date (Bill, 10 November 2026) == Optional '''blanked''' — the date the Players Committee blanked the card (in effect banned it), with a to the announcement, e.g. |blanked=26 April 2011.... It shows a ''Blanked'' row after ''Era'' and adds [[:Category:Blanked cards]]. Blanking is not a new version: the card stays in its set and is legal in period formats before that date. Leave it out on cards that were never blanked (no row is shown). == Language and printing metadata == Optional '''language''' — ISO language code for this printing, for example ja. Shows the printed-language row and enables optional edition metadata. Omit for existing English entries. '''language_display''' supplies a sourced display value instead of the language name; '''label_language''' preserves an existing row label. '''printed_title''', '''printed_game_text''' and '''printed_lore''' hold the printing's native text, including its punctuation and title markers. They render in their own language-tagged sections. '''translation''' holds the English translation separately; '''translation_note''' holds a comparison with the English printing. Never substitute English card text for an unreadable Japanese face. Preserve a distinction between a blank printed field and a field that has not been transcribed. Optional '''edition''', '''border_finish''', '''release''', '''size''' and '''year''' show metadata rows when supplied together with '''language'''. Set identifies the product; '''set_icon''' identifies the symbol actually printed on this face. A foil or introductory product can reuse another expansion's symbol or print the premium symbol. Read the face rather than inferring its symbol from the product name. The migration also supports existing article material through '''lead''', '''navigation''', '''image_note''', '''type_display''', '''set_display''', '''rarity_display''', '''extra_info''', '''extra_sections''' and '''see_also_heading'''. Display overrides preserve existing linked wording without changing the underlying side/type/set values. '''extra_info''' accepts table rows inside the shared infobox; it must not contain another infobox table. The '''label_type''', '''label_gemp_id''', '''label_dark_icons''', '''label_light_icons''', '''label_icons''', '''label_landspeed''' and '''label_versions''' overrides retain existing field labels. '''category_override''' retains an exceptional printing's complete existing category list; omit it for ordinary new entries. Example of separate native and translated fields (an abridged language-field example; add the verified image, statistics, Versions and sources for a complete article): 
{{Card
|title=Alderaan
|side=Light
|type=Location
|subtype=System
|set=Premiere (Japanese)
|language=ja
|set_icon=None ([[Premiere Limited|Premiere]])
|printed_title=オルデラン
|translation='''Title:''' Alderaan.
}}
== Source-photo orientation == Optional '''image_rotation''' — left displays the first portrait a quarter turn counterclockwise. Use it for an original source photograph whose card is sideways. The original File and downloaded photograph stay unchanged. Omit it for an upright photo. '''image_rotated_height''' is the displayed height in pixels after rotation; use the nearest integer to 280 × original image width / original image height (default 167). The template scales the standard thumbnail inside its 280px rail. Works with the first portrait in stacked and two-column layouts. Do not use rotation to infer a different printing or to hide a cropped card edge. === Framing source photographs === For a photograph containing a grading holder, retain the original image filename and provide image_source_width, image_crop_x, image_crop_y, image_crop_width and image_crop_height in original source pixels. These optional fields frame the complete physical card for display without altering the uploaded source. image_rotation accepts left, right or 180 in this mode. An optional image_crop_polygon removes only background around a perspective photograph; preserve every card edge. The display includes an explicit link to the original photograph. Unframed photographs and secondary-image trim parameters keep their existing behavior.

It is a foil printing of the [[A New Hope]] card.[[:File:Reflections-Foil-L-Attack-Run-PSA-72605733-original.jpg|Original printed Reflections foil face]], PSA certification 72605733. |game_text=Deploy on Death Star: Trench.
During your move phase, you may make an Attack Run as follows:
'''Enter Trench:''' Move up to 3 of your starfighters into trench (for free). Dark Side may immediately follow with up to 3 TIEs (for free).
'''Provide Cover:''' Identify your lead starfighter (Proton Torpedoes* required) and wingmen (if any). Turbolaser Batteries and TIEs with weapons may now target your starfighters (wingmen first, then lead if no wingmen remaining). Hit starfighters are immediately lost.
'''It’s Away!:''' Draw two destiny.
'''Pull Up!:''' All starfighters now move to Death Star system (for free).
If (total destiny + X + Y - Z) > 15, Death Star is “blown away.”
X = ability of lead pilot or 3 if Targeting Computer is present.
Y = total sites at largest Rebel Base (Yavin 4 or Hoth).
Z = highest ability of TIE pilots in trench.
*Your Proton Torpedoes are immune to Overload. |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Attack Run]]

Card Size | 63x88mm |} '''Reflections: A Collector's Bounty''' (sold as '''Reflections''') is the 23rd Star Wars CCG product, published by Decipher in January 2000. It is 114 foil cards (57 per side): 87 very rare foils, 25 super rare foils, and 2 ultra rare foils ([[Darth Vader]] and [[Luke Skywalker]]). Displays shipped with oversized, non-playable objective box toppers. Packs are 18 cards, MSRP $4.95, 30 packs per box. Each pack has '''one foil''' from the list below plus random reprints from earlier expansions. Those reprints are not listed here. A foil of a title not on this list is not a Reflections pack foil. It may be a later [[Promotional Foils|promotional foil]], a Japanese foil, or a counterfeit.[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]. == Packaging == {| class="wikitable" style="background:transparent; border:none;" |- style="background:transparent; border:none; vertical-align:bottom;" | style="border:none; text-align:center;" | [[File:Reflections-display.png|260px|Reflections display]]
''Display'' | style="border:none; text-align:center;" | [[File:Reflections-pack.png|200px|Reflections pack]]
''18-card pack'' |} == Box toppers == Each display included one of two '''oversized''' (about 5″ × 7″) objective cards. They are promotional / non-playable and are '''not''' part of the 114 pack foils: * [[Mind What You Have Learned / Save You It Can]] * [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe]] [[File:Reflections-box-toppers.png|640px|Reflections oversized box toppers]] == Foil cards == The 114 pack foils by side and rarity: Click a card image or title to open that foil printing. During your move phase, you may make an Attack Run as follows:

'''Enter Trench:''' Move up to 3 of your starfighters into trench (for free). Dark Side may immediately follow with up to 3 TIEs (for free).

'''Provide Cover:''' Identify your lead starfighter (Proton Torpedoes* required) and wingmen (if any). Turbolaser Batteries and TIEs with weapons may now target your starfighters (wingmen first, then lead if no wingmen remaining). Hit starfighters are immediately lost.

'''It’s Away!:''' Draw two destiny.

'''Pull Up!:''' All starfighters now move to Death Star system (for free).

If (total destiny + X + Y - Z) > 15, Death Star is “blown away.”

X = ability of lead pilot or 3 if Targeting Computer is present.

Y = total sites at largest Rebel Base (Yavin 4 or Hoth).

Z = highest ability of TIE pilots in trench.

{| class="wikitable expansion-infobox" ! colspan="2" | Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy |- | colspan="2" style="text-align:center;" | [[File:Reflections-II-display.png|260px]] |- ! Game/Set | Star Wars CCG |- ! Expansion | Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy |- ! Publisher | Decipher |- ! Country | USA |- ! Date | January 2001 |- ! Language | English |- ! Cards Total | 154 |- ! Card Size | 63x88mm |} '''Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy''' is the 28th Star Wars CCG product, published by Decipher on 10 January 2001. It is 154 cards (77 per side): 34 very rare foils, 62 super rare foils, 4 ultra rare foils, and 54 premium cards, plus five foil box/case toppers. Packs are 18 cards, MSRP $4.95, 30 packs per box. Each pack has '''one foil''' from the list below, two unique premiums (listed under Card list), and random reprints. Those reprints are not listed. Some packs did not contain a Japanese card. A foil of a title that is not on this list (and is not one of the box/case toppers) is not a Decipher Reflections II pack foil.[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive] == Packaging == {| class="wikitable" style="background:transparent; border:none;" |- style="background:transparent; border:none; vertical-align:bottom;" | style="border:none; text-align:center;" | [[File:Reflections-II-display.png|260px|Reflections II display]]
''Display'' | style="border:none; text-align:center;" | [[File:Reflections-II-pack.png|200px|Reflections II pack]]
''18-card pack'' |} == Box toppers == Displays shipped with foil '''box toppers''' of Enhanced Premiere characters, plus a Japanese [[Darth Vader]] '''case topper'''. These titles also appear on the foil print sheets (two copies per sheet) and are playable foils: * [[Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle]] * [[Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol]] * [[Leia With Blaster Rifle]] * [[Obi-Wan With Lightsaber]] * Japanese [[Darth Vader (Japanese Reflections II Foil)|Darth Vader]] (case topper) == Japanese-language foils == Complete Card List v4 marks six Reflections II pack/case foils as Japanese-language printings. [[Darth Vader (Japanese Reflections II Foil)|Darth Vader]] is the case topper. The others are pack foils listed below. These are Japanese-language foils inside Reflections II, not a Japanese Reflections set.[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 30–31. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009184033/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Internet Archive]. * [[Darth Vader (Japanese Reflections II Foil)|Darth Vader]] (R10, P, case topper) * [[Death Star (Japanese Reflections II Foil)|Death Star]] (R32, SR) * [[Imperial Walker (Japanese Reflections II Foil)|Imperial Walker]] (R49, SR) * [[Brainiac (Japanese Reflections II Foil)|Brainiac]] (R56, SR) * [[Leia (Japanese Reflections II Foil)|Leia]] (R63, SR) * [[Rebel Snowspeeder (Japanese Reflections II Foil)|Rebel Snowspeeder]] (R104, SR) == Memorabilia == The booster box held a fold-out Rules Supplement (Expanded Universe notes, combo-card rules, and the collector's card list): {| class="wikitable" style="background:transparent; border:none;" |- style="background:transparent; vertical-align:top;" | style="border:none; text-align:center;" | [[File:Reflections-II-rules-supplement-front.png|360px|Reflections II rules supplement front]]
''Rules side'' | style="border:none; text-align:center;" | [[File:Reflections-II-rules-supplement-back.png|360px|Reflections II rules supplement back]]
''Card list'' |} == Print sheets == Foils and premiums are 11×11 (121 cards). Light foil sheet: 3 box toppers 2×, 1 ultra rare, 15 very rare 3×, 34 super rare 2×, 1 blank. Dark foil sheet: 1 case topper 2×, 1 box topper 2×, 1 ultra rare, 19 very rare 3×, 28 super rare 2×, 1 blank. Premium sheet: 27 titles (15 four times and 12 five times) plus 1 blank. == Exclusive cards == === [[Light|Light Side]] === ==== [[Character]] ==== {| class="wikitable card-thumbs" ! Image !! Card !! Type !! Rarity !! Destiny !! All droids may be battled. Any player that has no ability in a battle takes no battle damage. Once per turn, may take one card with 'Bad Feeling' in title into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Immune to attrition < 4 (< 5 while an Imperial leader aboard, < 6 while Thrawn aboard). |- | {{Card photograph|file=Reflections-II-Foil-D-Darth-Vader-With-Lightsaber-PSA-photo-136033854-original.jpg|source_width=1441|crop_x=143|crop_y=616|crop_width=1161|crop_height=1615|rotation=|width=200|link=Darth Vader With Lightsaber (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Darth Vader With Lightsaber (Reflections II Foil)}} || [[Darth Vader With Lightsaber (Reflections II Foil)|Darth Vader With Lightsaber]] || English || [[Character]] — [[Imperial|Imperial]] || SR || 1 || Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. Permanent weapon is •Vader’s Lightsaber (may target a character or creature for free; draw two destiny; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value). |- | {{Card photograph|file=Reflections-II-Foil-D-Darth-Vader-s-Lightsaber-PSA-photo-148471839-original.jpg|source_width=1438|crop_x=205|crop_y=683|crop_width=1022|crop_height=1464|rotation=|width=200|link=Darth Vader's Lightsaber (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Darth Vader's Lightsaber (Reflections II Foil)}} || [[Darth Vader's Lightsaber (Reflections II Foil)|Darth Vader's Lightsaber]] || English || [[Weapon]] — [[Character Weapon|Character Weapon]] || SR || 1 || Deploy on Vader. May target a character or creature. Draw two destiny. Target hit if total destiny > defense value. Also, during a duel, Vader may ‘throw’ this lightsaber to add 1 to each of his duel destiny draws (place lightsaber in Used Pile at end of duel). |- | [[File:Japanese-Death-Star-Reflections-II-Foil-SWCA.jpg|200px|link=Death Star (Japanese Reflections II Foil)|alt=Death Star, Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy foil, Japanese]] || [[Death Star (Japanese Reflections II Foil)|Death Star]]
デス・スター || Japanese || [[Location]] || SR || X || '''Light Side:'''
'''Dark Side:''' X＝現在位置のパーセク数。パーセク0に配備する。航行速度＝1。「革命」の影響を受けない。ゲーム開始時に出したならライトサイドが先攻。 |- | {{Card photograph|file=Reflections-II-Foil-D-Death-Star-II-PSA-photo-63394541-original.jpg|source_width=891|crop_x=198|crop_y=370|crop_width=505|crop_height=652|rotation=|width=200|link=Death Star II (Dark) (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Death Star II (Dark) (Reflections II Foil)|polygon=3.1683% 0.3067%,93.4653% 0%,100% 99.6933%,0% 100%}} || [[Death Star II (Dark) (Reflections II Foil)|Death Star II]] || English || [[Location]] — [[System|System]] || SR || || '''Light Side:'''
'''Dark Side:''' X = parsec of current position. Must deploy orbiting Endor. Death Star II locations are immune to Revolution. Opponent’s Force drains +3 here unless That Thing’s Operational on table. |- | [[File:Reflections-II-Foil-D-Dengar-In-Punishing-One-SWCA-photo-68033-original.jpg|200px|link=Dengar In Punishing One (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Dengar In Punishing One, Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy foil, English]] || [[Dengar In Punishing One (Reflections II Foil)|Dengar In Punishing One]] || English || [[Starship]] — [[Starfighter|Starfighter]] || SR || 1 || Permanent pilot is •Dengar, who provides ability of 2 and adds 2 to power. When in battle, adds 1 to total battle destiny for each opponent’s starship present. Cancels opponent’s immunity to attrition here. |- | {{Card photograph|file=Reflections-II-Foil-D-Dengar-With-Blaster-Carbine-PSA-photo-212668039-original.jpg|source_width=1439|crop_x=217|crop_y=707|crop_width=1018|crop_height=1466|rotation=|width=200|link=Dengar With Blaster Carbine (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Dengar With Blaster Carbine (Reflections II Foil)}} || [[Dengar With Blaster Carbine (Reflections II Foil)|Dengar With Blaster Carbine]] || English || [[Character]] — [[Alien|Alien]] || SR || 2 || Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Permanent weapon is •Dengar’s Blaster Carbine (may target a character, creature, or vehicle for free; target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +1 > defense value; may be fired twice per battle). |- | [[File:Reflections-II-Foil-D-Djas-Puhr-SWCA-photo-68035-original.jpg|200px|link=Djas Puhr (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Djas Puhr, Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy foil, English]] || [[Djas Puhr (Reflections II Foil)|Djas Puhr]] || English || [[Character]] — [[Alien|Alien]] || SR || 1 || Power +1 for each [[Dark Force]] icon present, +2 under “nighttime conditions.” Immune to attrition < 3. |- | {{Card photograph|file=Reflections-II-Foil-D-Dreadnaught-Class-Heavy-Cruiser-PSA-photo-210975394-original.jpg|source_width=1436|crop_x=131|crop_y=635|crop_width=1176|crop_height=1605|rotation=|width=200|link=Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser (Reflections II Foil)}} || [[Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser (Reflections II Foil)|Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser]] || English || [[Starship]] — [[Capital Starship|Capital Starship]] || SR || 3 || May add 3 pilots, 6 passengers and 4 TIEs. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilots provide total ability of 2. Turbolaser Battery may deploy aboard. Your TIEs present are each power +1. |- | {{Card photograph|file=Reflections-II-Foil-D-Flagship-Executor-PSA-photo-133845430-original.jpg|source_width=1777|crop_x=192|crop_y=801|crop_width=1400|crop_height=1963|rotation=left|width=200|link=Flagship Executor (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Flagship Executor (Reflections II Foil)}} || [[Flagship Executor (Reflections II Foil)|Flagship Executor]] || English || [[Starship]] — [[Capital Starship|Capital Starship]] || SR || 4 || May add unlimited pilots, passengers, and starfighters. Has ship-docking capability. Permanent pilot provides ability of 3. Immune to attrition if target of Flagship Operations. |- | {{Card photograph|file=Reflections-II-Foil-D-Force-Lightning-PSA-photo-141063282-original.jpg|source_width=1447|crop_x=198|crop_y=681|crop_width=1032|crop_height=1458|rotation=|width=200|link=Force Lightning (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Force Lightning (Reflections II Foil)}} || [[Force Lightning (Reflections II Foil)|Force Lightning]] || English || [[Interrupt]] — [[Used Or Lost Interrupt|Used Or Lost Interrupt]] || SR || 5 || Target any character (even a captive) present with Emperor. USED: Target is defense value −4 for remainder of turn. LOST: Emperor loses immunity to attrition and is defense value −2 for remainder of turn. Draw destiny. Target lost if destiny +1 > defense value. |- | {{Card photograph|file=Reflections-II-Foil-D-IG-88-With-Riot-Gun-PSA-photo-197480766-original.jpg|source_width=1436|crop_x=196|crop_y=683|crop_width=1053|crop_height=1476|rotation=|width=200|link=IG-88 With Riot Gun (Reflections II Foil)|alt=IG-88 With Riot Gun (Reflections II Foil)}} || [[IG-88 With Riot Gun (Reflections II Foil)|IG-88 With Riot Gun]] || English || [[Character]] — [[Droid|Droid]] || SR || 1 || May initiate battle. Permanent weapon is riot gun (may target a character for free; draw destiny; target captured if destiny +1 > defense value). Adds one battle destiny if alone or with your other bounty hunter. Immune to Restraining Bolt and purchase. |- | [[File:Japanese-Imperial-Walker-Reflections-II-Foil-SWCA.jpg|200px|link=Imperial Walker (Japanese Reflections II Foil)|alt=Imperial Walker, Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy foil, Japanese]] || [[Imperial Walker (Japanese Reflections II Foil)|Imperial Walker]]
インペリアル・ウォーカー || Japanese || [[Vehicle]] || SR || 2 || 1名のパイロットと8名の乗客を搭乗させられる。能力値1の専属パイロットが搭乗している。 |- | {{Card photograph|file=Reflections-II-Foil-D-Jodo-Kast-PSA-photo-174882164-original.jpg|source_width=1443|crop_x=150|crop_y=621|crop_width=1137|crop_height=1586|rotation=|width=200|link=Jodo Kast (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Jodo Kast (Reflections II Foil)}} || [[Jodo Kast (Reflections II Foil)|Jodo Kast]] || English || [[Character]] — [[Alien|Alien]] || SR || 2 || When in battle, if opponent draws more than one battle destiny, may cancel one. Once per turn, when firing a rifle or blaster, may target for free and add 2 to total weapon destiny. May be targeted by Hidden Weapons. May ‘fly’ (landspeed = 3). |- | {{Card photograph|file=Reflections-II-Foil-D-Mara-Jade-s-Lightsaber-PSA-photo-176794185-original.jpg|source_width=2429|crop_x=262|crop_y=1082|crop_width=1914|crop_height=2652|rotation=|width=200|link=Mara Jade's Lightsaber (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Mara Jade's Lightsaber (Reflections II Foil)}} || [[Mara Jade's Lightsaber (Reflections II Foil)|Mara Jade's Lightsaber]] || English || [[Weapon]] — [[Character Weapon|Character Weapon]] || SR || 1 || Use 1 Force to deploy on Mara Jade. May add 1 to Force drain where present. May target a character or creature for free. Draw two destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if total destiny > defense value. |- | {{Card photograph|file=Reflections-II-Foil-D-Moff-Jerjerrod-PSA-photo-212668036-original.jpg|source_width=1433|crop_x=153|crop_y=642|crop_width=1158|crop_height=1596|rotation=|width=200|link=Moff Jerjerrod (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Moff Jerjerrod (Reflections II Foil)}} || [[Moff Jerjerrod (Reflections II Foil)|Moff Jerjerrod]] || English || [[Character]] — [[Imperial|Imperial]] || SR || 1 || Adds 2 to power of any capital starship he pilots. Once during each of your turns, you may take one Death Star II sector or Superlaser Mark II into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Prevents opponent’s spies from deploying to same Death Star II site. |- | {{Card photograph|file=Reflections-II-Foil-D-Outer-Rim-Scout-PSA-photo-141063287-original.jpg|source_width=1453|crop_x=203|crop_y=685|crop_width=1027|crop_height=1464|rotation=|width=200|link=Outer Rim Scout (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Outer Rim Scout (Reflections II Foil)}} || [[Outer Rim Scout (Reflections II Foil)|Outer Rim Scout]] || English || [[Character]] — [[Alien|Alien]] || SR || 2 || Deploy −1 to your [[Independent]] starship. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. When piloting a [[Independent]] starship, instead adds 3 to power and draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. Suspends Asteroid Sanctuary at related sector. |- | {{Card photograph|file=Reflections-II-Foil-D-Tempest-Scout-1-PSA-photo-180919051-original.jpg|source_width=1433|crop_x=208|crop_y=685|crop_width=1019|crop_height=1464|rotation=|width=200|link=Tempest Scout 1 (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Tempest Scout 1 (Reflections II Foil)}} || [[Tempest Scout 1 (Reflections II Foil)|Tempest Scout 1]] || English || [[Vehicle]] — [[Combat Vehicle|Combat Vehicle]] || SR || 3 || May add 2 pilots or passengers. May move as a ‘react’ for free. When Arnet piloting, immune to attrition < 4 and adds 1 to attrition against opponent. |- | {{Card photograph|file=Reflections-II-Foil-D-The-Emperor-s-Shield-PSA-photo-137870033-original.jpg|source_width=1428|crop_x=155|crop_y=635|crop_width=1123|crop_height=1574|rotation=|width=200|link=The Emperor's Shield (Reflections II Foil)|alt=The Emperor's Shield (Reflections II Foil)}} || [[The Emperor's Shield (Reflections II Foil)|The Emperor's Shield]] || English || [[Starship]] — [[Squadron|Squadron]] || SR || 2 || Deploys −2 to Endor, Death Star II, or same location as Thrawn. May deploy as a ‘react’. Permanent pilots provide total ability of 3. Power +3 at Endor or when Emperor is at same or related location. |- | {{Card photograph|file=Reflections-II-Foil-D-The-Emperor-s-Sword-PSA-photo-140931633-original.jpg|source_width=1414|crop_x=198|crop_y=681|crop_width=1017|crop_height=1456|rotation=|width=200|link=The Emperor's Sword (Reflections II Foil)|alt=The Emperor's Sword (Reflections II Foil)}} || [[The Emperor's Sword (Reflections II Foil)|The Emperor's Sword]] || English || [[Starship]] — [[Squadron|Squadron]] || SR || 2 || Deploys −2 to Coruscant or Death Star II. May deploy as a ‘react’. Permanent pilots provide total ability of 3. Power +3 at Coruscant or when Emperor is at same or related location. |- | [[File:Reflections-II-Foil-D-Trample-SWCA-photo-68048-original.jpg|200px|link=Trample (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Trample, Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy foil, English]] || [[Trample (Reflections II Foil)|Trample]] || English || [[Interrupt]] — [[Used Interrupt|Used Interrupt]] || SR || 4 || If you have a piloted AT-AT or AT-ST present at a site, target opponent’s character, ‘crashed’ vehicle, or unpiloted vehicle with maneuver present. Draw destiny. Character lost if destiny > ability. Vehicle lost if destiny < 7. |- | {{Card photograph|file=Reflections-II-Foil-D-Walker-Garrison-PSA-photo-175880457-original.jpg|source_width=1426|crop_x=203|crop_y=700|crop_width=1027|crop_height=1456|rotation=|width=200|link=Walker Garrison (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Walker Garrison (Reflections II Foil)}} || [[Walker Garrison (Reflections II Foil)|Walker Garrison]] || English || [[Interrupt]] — [[Lost Interrupt|Lost Interrupt]] || SR || 4 || If Veers is at an exterior Hoth site, use 2 Force to take one AT-AT into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. OR If you have AT-ATs at three different Hoth sites, your Force drains are +2 at Hoth locations this turn. |- | {{Card photograph|file=Reflections-II-Foil-D-Zuckuss-In-Mist-Hunter-PSA-photo-212668038-original.jpg|source_width=1434|crop_x=131|crop_y=618|crop_width=1154|crop_height=1598|rotation=|width=200|link=Zuckuss In Mist Hunter (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Zuckuss In Mist Hunter (Reflections II Foil)}} || [[Zuckuss In Mist Hunter (Reflections II Foil)|Zuckuss In Mist Hunter]] || English || [[Starship]] — [[Starfighter|Starfighter]] || SR || 1 || May add 1 pilot and 3 passengers. Permanent pilot is •Zuckuss, who provides ability of 4 and adds 2 to power. Unless opponent has total ability > 6 piloting here, opponent’s total battle destiny here = zero. |- | [[File:Reflections-II-Foil-D-Bad-Feeling-Have-I-SWCA-photo-68051-original.jpg|200px|link=Bad Feeling Have I (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Bad Feeling Have I, Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy foil, English]] || [[Bad Feeling Have I (Reflections II Foil)|Bad Feeling Have I]] || English || [[Effect]] || VR || 3 || Deploy on opponent’s side of table. Luke, Leia, Han, Chewie, Lando, Yoda and Obi-Wan are each deploy +2. Also, opponent may not play any cards with the words “bad feeling” in the title. |- | [[File:Reflections-II-Foil-D-Black-Squadron-TIE-SWCA-photo-68052-original.jpg|200px|link=Black Squadron TIE (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Black Squadron TIE, Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy foil, English]] || [[Black Squadron TIE (Reflections II Foil)|Black Squadron TIE]] || English || [[Starship]] — [[Starfighter|Starfighter]] || VR || 2 || Deploy −2 to same location as Darth Vader or at Death Star. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2 and adds 2 to power. Adds 1 to its weapon destiny draws. |- | [[File:Reflections-II-Foil-D-Boelo-SWCA-photo-68053-original.jpg|200px|link=Boelo (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Boelo, Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy foil, English]] || [[Boelo (Reflections II Foil)|Boelo]] || English || [[Character]] — [[Alien|Alien]] || VR || 1 || Deploys only on Tatooine or to same location as Jabba. When in a battle either at Audience Chamber or with your alien leader, may cancel one opponent’s battle destiny just drawn. |- | [[File:Reflections-II-Foil-D-Chall-Bekan-SWCA-photo-68054-original.jpg|200px|link=Chall Bekan (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Chall Bekan, Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy foil, English]] || [[Chall Bekan (Reflections II Foil)|Chall Bekan]] || English || [[Character]] — [[Alien|Alien]] || VR || 2 || When deployed, you may take one non-unique alien into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Your aliens deploy −1 to same or adjacent Tatooine site. |- | [[File:Reflections-II-Foil-D-Commander-Igar-SWCA-photo-68055-original.jpg|200px|link=Commander Igar (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Commander Igar, Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy foil, English]] || [[Commander Igar (Reflections II Foil)|Commander Igar]] || English || [[Character]] — [[Imperial|Imperial]] || VR || 1 || Adds 3 to power of any combat vehicle he pilots. When piloting Tempest 1 or a non-unique AT-AT, adds one battle destiny. When in battle with Veers or Tagge, may use 2 Force to cancel and redraw one just-drawn battle destiny. |- | [[File:Reflections-II-Foil-D-Death-Star-II-Throne-Room-SWCA-photo-68056-original.jpg|200px|link=Death Star II: Throne Room (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Death Star II: Throne Room, Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy foil, English]] || [[Death Star II: Throne Room (Reflections II Foil)|Death Star II: Throne Room]] || English || [[Location]] — [[Site|Site]] || VR || || '''Dark Side:''' Once per game, you may take Emperor’s Power into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.
'''Light Side:''' Immune to Revolution. |- | [[File:Reflections-II-Foil-D-Executor-Holotheatre-SWCA-photo-68057-original.jpg|200px|link=Executor: Holotheatre (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Executor: Holotheatre, Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy foil, English]] || [[Executor: Holotheatre (Reflections II Foil)|Executor: Holotheatre]] || English || [[Location]] — [[Site|Site]] || VR || || '''Dark Side:''' If Vader or Emperor Palpatine on table, your Force generation is +1 here (+2 if both).
'''Light Side:''' Force drain +1 here. |- | [[File:Reflections-II-Foil-D-Executor-Meditation-Chamber-SWCA-photo-68058-original.jpg|200px|link=Executor: Meditation Chamber (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Executor: Meditation Chamber, Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy foil, English]] || [[Executor: Meditation Chamber (Reflections II Foil)|Executor: Meditation Chamber]] || English || [[Location]] — [[Site|Site]] || VR || || '''Dark Side:''' If Vader alone here, once per turn, may apply his ability to draw battle destiny at any system.
'''Light Side:''' If you occupy, opponent’s Meditation Chamber game text is canceled. |- | [[File:Reflections-II-Foil-D-Fighters-Coming-In-SWCA-photo-68060-original.jpg|200px|link=Fighters Coming In (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Fighters Coming In, Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy foil, English]] || [[Fighters Coming In (Reflections II Foil)|Fighters Coming In]] || English || [[Admiral's Order]] || VR || 6 || Unique (•) starfighters without permanent pilots are immune to attrition < 4 (or add 2 to immunity if starfighter already has immunity). Starships without pilot characters aboard are power −2. At docking bays related to systems you occupy, your Force drains are +1. Once per turn, your starfighter just lost from a system may be relocated to a related docking bay. |- | [[File:Reflections-II-Foil-D-Hoth-Wampa-Cave-SWCA-photo-68061-original.jpg|200px|link=Hoth: Wampa Cave (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Hoth: Wampa Cave, Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy foil, English]] || [[Hoth: Wampa Cave (Reflections II Foil)|Hoth: Wampa Cave]] || English || [[Location]] — [[Site|Site]] || VR || || '''Dark Side:''' Your wampas deploy free here.
'''Light Side:''' If Main Power Generators on table, Force drain −1 here. |- | {{Card photograph|file=Reflections-II-Foil-D-IG-88-In-IG-2000-PSA-photo-140931632-original.jpg|source_width=1432|crop_x=210|crop_y=683|crop_width=1039|crop_height=1464|rotation=|width=200|link=IG-88 In IG-2000 (Reflections II Foil)|alt=IG-88 In IG-2000 (Reflections II Foil)}} || [[IG-88 In IG-2000 (Reflections II Foil)|IG-88 In IG-2000]] || English || [[Starship]] — [[Starfighter|Starfighter]] || VR || 1 || May add 2 passengers. Permanent pilot is •IG-88, who adds 2 to power and 3 to maneuver. May initiate battle. When in a battle you initiate, adds one battle destiny. Ion Cannon may deploy aboard. |- | [[File:Reflections-II-Foil-D-Janus-Greejatus-SWCA-photo-68063-original.jpg|200px|link=Janus Greejatus (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Janus Greejatus, Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy foil, English]] || [[Janus Greejatus (Reflections II Foil)|Janus Greejatus]] || English || [[Character]] — [[Imperial|Imperial]] || VR || 2 || Deploys −3 to Emperor’s site. When with Emperor at a battleground site, adds 1 to your Force drains here. Once per turn, you may use 1 Force to place a card from hand on bottom of Used Pile and draw top card of Reserve Deck. Immune to attrition < 3. |- | [[File:Reflections-II-Foil-D-Kiffex-SWCA-photo-68064-original.jpg|200px|link=Kiffex (Dark) (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Kiffex, Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy foil, English]] || [[Kiffex (Dark) (Reflections II Foil)|Kiffex]] || English || [[Location]] — [[System|System]] || VR || || '''Dark Side:''' If you occupy with exactly 2 starships, your total power here is +2 and Tonnika Sisters anywhere are doubled.
'''Light Side:''' If you occupy with exactly 2 starships, your total power here is +2. |- | [[File:Reflections-II-Foil-D-Lateral-Damage-SWCA-photo-68065-original.jpg|200px|link=Lateral Damage (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Lateral Damage, Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy foil, English]] || [[Lateral Damage (Reflections II Foil)|Lateral Damage]] || English || [[Effect]] — [[Utinni Effect|Utinni Effect]] || VR || 4 || Deploy on any system. Target an opponent’s starship. Target’s power and forfeit = 0. When target reaches Utinni Effect, target draws one destiny. Utinni Effect canceled if destiny > 2. Otherwise, draw again next move phase, etc. |- | {{Card photograph|file=Reflections-II-Foil-D-Myn-Kyneugh-PSA-photo-195786194-original.jpg|source_width=1432|crop_x=154|crop_y=641|crop_width=1129|crop_height=1570|rotation=|width=200|link=Myn Kyneugh (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Myn Kyneugh (Reflections II Foil)}} || [[Myn Kyneugh (Reflections II Foil)|Myn Kyneugh]] || English || [[Character]] — [[Imperial|Imperial]] || VR || 4 || Deploys only on Coruscant or to Emperor’s site (or related site). When armed with a Force pike, adds one battle destiny. Your troopers and Royal Guards may ‘react’ to here for free. Adds 1 to defense value of other Royal Guards at same and related sites. |- | [[File:Reflections-II-Foil-D-Scum-And-Villainy-SWCA-photo-68067-original.jpg|200px|link=Scum And Villainy (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Scum And Villainy, Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy foil, English]] || [[Scum And Villainy (Reflections II Foil)|Scum And Villainy]] || English || [[Effect]] || VR || 4 || Deploy on Audience Chamber. While all your ability on table is provided only by aliens and [[Independent]] starship pilots, your aliens and starships deploy −1 and you retrieve 2 Force when you initiate battle. (Immune to Alter if you control at least three Jabba’s Palace sites.) |- | [[File:Reflections-II-Foil-D-Sienar-Fleet-Systems-SWCA-photo-68068-original.jpg|200px|link=Sienar Fleet Systems (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Sienar Fleet Systems, Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy foil, English]] || [[Sienar Fleet Systems (Reflections II Foil)|Sienar Fleet Systems]] || English || [[Effect]] || VR || 3 || Deploy on Wakeelmui system. Each time you deploy a TIE, retrieve 1 Force (or 3 if a TIE squadron). Also, once per turn you may relocate a TIE just lost from table to Used Pile. (Immune to Alter while you occupy Wakeelmui.) |- | [[File:Reflections-II-Foil-D-Sim-Aloo-SWCA-photo-68069-original.jpg|200px|link=Sim Aloo (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Sim Aloo, Reflections II: Expanding the Galaxy foil, English]] || [[Sim Aloo (Reflections II Foil)|Sim Aloo]] || English || [[Character]] — [[Imperial|Imperial]] || VR || 1 || Deploys −3 to Emperor’s site. When with Emperor, adds one battle destiny. Once per turn, you may use 1 Force to peek at top card of opponent’s Reserve Deck; may place that card on bottom of that Reserve Deck. Immune to attrition < 4. |- | {{Card photograph|file=Reflections-II-Foil-D-Vader-s-Obsession-PSA-photo-135681217-original.jpg|source_width=1423|crop_x=153|crop_y=641|crop_width=1121|crop_height=1570|rotation=|width=200|link=Vader's Obsession (Reflections II Foil)|alt=Vader's Obsession (Reflections II Foil)}} || [[Vader's Obsession (Reflections II Foil)|Vader's Obsession]] || English || [[Interrupt]] — [[Lost Interrupt|Lost Interrupt]] || VR || 6 || During your move phase, if Vader moves to Luke’s site from an adjacent site, begin a duel between them. Each adds two destiny to power. Winner retrieves Force equal to the difference. Loser loses same amount of Force, plus the character. |}

Card Size | 63x88mm |} '''Reflections III''' is the 31st Star Wars CCG product, published by Decipher on 31 October 2001. It has 200 cards (100 per side): 100 foils and 100 non-foil premiums. Packs are 18 cards, MSRP $4.95, 30 packs per box. Each pack has '''one foil''' from the list below plus three unique premiums (listed under Card list)[https://web.archive.org/web/20081225225012/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/index.html Star Wars CCG cardlists], Decipher.com (archive, 25 December 2008) and random reprints from Premiere through Endor. Those reprints are not listed. A foil of a title that is not on this list is not a Decipher Reflections III pack foil (it may be a [[Promotional Foils|promotional foil]] or a counterfeit).[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2].
